title: Comparing Alkalinizing Agents Efficacy on Stone Risk in Patients on a Metabolically Controlled Diet
official: Evaluation of Multiple Alkalinizing Agents on Urinary Stone Risk Parameters in Stone and Non-stone Formers on a Metabolically Controlled Diet
summary: The purpose of this study is to compare over the counter and alternative prescription urinary alkalinizing agents to slow release potassium citrate in their ability to modify urinary parameters associated with stone formation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18 and older.
* with or without a history of stone disease.

Exclusion Criteria:

* They are unable to take any of the medications due to health reasons.
* Participants are pregnant or nursing.
* Participants are unable to adhere to the metabolic diet.
* Participants had a prior adverse event from one or more of the medications.
